```{r}
#a flow chart to describe PATH workflow -------------------------------
library(DiagrammeR)

PATH_workflow <- grViz(
  "digraph {

    graph [layout = dot, rankdir = LR, splines = ortho, nodesep = 1.5, ranksep = 0.3]
    node  [fontname = Helvetica, fontsize = 11, style = filled, fillcolor = white, color = gray35]
    edge  [color = gray30, arrowsize = 0.7]

    # Datasets (cylinders)
    IST    [label = 'IST', shape = cylinder, fillcolor = 'azure']
    GUSTO  [label = 'GUSTO-1', shape = cylinder, fillcolor = 'azure']
    DIG    [label = 'DIG', shape = cylinder, fillcolor = 'azure']
    VITAL  [label = 'VITAL', shape = cylinder, fillcolor = 'azure']

    # Core workflow
    clean   [label = 'Data cleaning']
    feature [label = 'Feature selection']
    rf      [label = 'Random Forest']
    logit   [label = 'Logistic Regression']
    quart   [label = 'Risk Quartiles']

    # Outputs
    rel     [shape = none, label = 'Forest Plot', shape = doubleoctagon, fillcolor = 'lightsalmon' ]
    abs     [label = 'Absolute Benefit Plot', shape = doubleoctagon, fillcolor = 'lightsalmon']

    classical [label = 'Classical\\nsubgroups', shape = box, fillcolor = 'mistyrose']

    # Flow
    IST   -> clean
    GUSTO -> clean
    DIG   -> clean
    VITAL -> clean

    clean   -> feature
    feature -> rf
    feature -> logit

    rf    -> quart
    logit -> quart

    quart -> rel
    quart -> abs

    classical -> rel [style = dashed, color = firebrick, fontcolor = firebrick]
  }"
)

PATH_workflow


saveRDS(PATH_workflow, "PATH_workflow.rds")
```



MC simulation under NUll etc...

```{r}
library(DiagrammeR)

MC_workflow <- grViz(
  "digraph {

    graph [layout = dot, rankdir = LR,
           splines = ortho,
           nodesep = 1.2,
           ranksep = 0.5]

    node  [fontname = Helvetica,
           fontsize = 11,
           style = filled,
           fillcolor = white,
           color = gray35]

    edge  [color = gray30,
           arrowsize = 0.7]

    # Simulation setup
    covar   [label = 'Generate Covariates\\n(X1, X2, X3)',
             shape = box,
             fillcolor = 'azure']

    trt     [label = 'Randomize Treatment\\n(Z ~ Bernoulli(0.5))',
             shape = box,
             fillcolor = 'azure']

    # Truth mechanisms
    null    [label = 'NULL Truth\\n(Constant treatment effect)',
             shape = box,
             fillcolor = 'honeydew']

    het     [label = 'HTE Truth\\n(Treatment × X1 interaction)',
             shape = box,
             fillcolor = 'mistyrose']

    # Outcome generation
    outcome [label = 'Generate Binary Outcome',
             shape = box]

    # PATH workflow
    risk    [label = 'Fit Prognostic\\nRisk Model',
             shape = box]

    predict [label = 'Predict Baseline Risk',
             shape = box]

    quart   [label = 'Create Risk Quartiles',
             shape = box]

    subgroup [label = 'Estimate Quartile\\nTreatment Effects',
              shape = box]

    forest  [label = 'Forest Plot',
             shape = doubleoctagon,
             fillcolor = 'lightsalmon']

    abs     [label = 'Absolute Benefit Plot',
             shape = doubleoctagon,
             fillcolor = 'lightsalmon']

    interaction [label = 'Interaction Test',
                 shape = box,
                 fillcolor = 'lavender']

    # MC repetition
    repeat  [label = 'Repeat B Times\\n(Monte Carlo Simulation)',
             shape = ellipse,
             fillcolor = 'khaki']

    summary [label = 'Summarize:\\nFalse positives\\nPower\\nBias\\nVariability',
             shape = doubleoctagon,
             fillcolor = 'lightblue']

    # Flow
    covar -> trt

    trt -> null
    trt -> het

    null -> outcome
    het  -> outcome

    outcome -> risk
    risk -> predict
    predict -> quart
    quart -> subgroup

    subgroup -> forest
    subgroup -> abs
    subgroup -> interaction

    forest -> repeat
    abs -> repeat
    interaction -> repeat

    repeat -> summary
  }"
)

MC_workflow

saveRDS(MC_workflow, "MC_workflow.rds")
```
